Name: Zechariah, Instructor of Uzziah
Role: Instructor in the Visions of God
Summary: Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God, instructed Uzziah, and as long as Uzziah sought the LORD, God made him prosper.
KeyStory: Uzziah sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God.
LifeLesson: A king's prosperity followed his seeking God under wise instruction.
